subject: Hospitality
title: Airbnb: The Great Disruption
description: A quick win: understand Airbnb: The Great Disruption.

hook.text: In 2007, two designers rented air mattresses in their apartment to conference attendees. Airbnb was born from desperation.

buildup.text: Airbnb let anyone rent their home to travelers. By 2023, it had 7+ million listings—more than the top hotel chains combined.

discovery.text: Airbnb proved travelers wanted 'local experiences,' not just rooms. Living like a local became the new luxury for some.

twist.text: Hotels fought back with lifestyle brands, local design, and 'authentic' experiences. Airbnb forced hotels to evolve.

climax.text: Cities passed regulations against short-term rentals. The disruption triggered a global policy battle still unresolved.

punchline.text: Air mattresses to 7 million listings. Hospitality got disrupted by guests.

quiz.question: How did Airbnb originally start?
options: Two designers rented air mattresses to conference attendees
